translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: SAN LUCAS
book.title: An alhua’ cau thuchath c’al an t’ocat inic Lucas

content: An jalpith cau c’al an oveja axi q’uibenec
Yantalam i bats’c’ul jalbixtalab tumin tin cuenta an gobierno ani axi exlath ti lej hualbith inicchic u che’el c’al a Jesús abal quin ats’anchi in cahuintal.

Jaxtam ti tsacul an fariseochic ani an exobchixchic c’al an ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés. In c’uiyath uluchic tin cuenta a Jesús antse’: ―Nixe’ xi inic im bats’uhual ani u junax c’apul c’al i hualbith inicchic.
Tam a Jesús in t’iloxnanchichic jun i jalpith cau antse’:

―¿Max a cua’al bo’ inic i oveja ani ca q’uibey jun jant’o ne’ets ca t’aja’? Auxe’ max yab i ne’ets ca jila’ axi tse’ inic c’al lajuj beleu biyat quit c’ale ca aliy axi jun q’uibenec ma tam ta ca ela’its.
Ani tam ca ela’its ne’ets ca antha’ ta punuc’ c’al a ichich lej culbel.
Quit ultsits ta q’uima’ ne’ets ca tamcuy a ja’ubchic ani a at q’uimathchic ani ca ucha’: Cu junax culbejits cum te u ela’its an oveja axi q’uibenec juncats.

Antsana’ nan tu uchalchic abal lej c’athpich u junax culbel an ángelchic ti eb tam jun i hualbith inic ca jic’tson c’al in hualab ani ca huenc’on c’al a Dios, ani yab ejtil c’al tse’ inic c’al lajuj beleu i inic ax in q’uibts’oth tsalpayalq’ui pel i alhua’ inic ani yab in yejenchal ca jic’tson c’al in hualab ani ca huenc’on c’al a Dios.
An jalpith cau c’al an tumin axi q’uibenec
¿Max jun i uxum in cua’al lajuj i tumin ani quin q’uiba’ jun jant’o ne’ets quin t’aja’? Auxe’ max yab i ne’ets quin lec’utsiy an tajablab ani quin tala’ c’uet’oy an ata ma tam quin ela’its.
Ani tam quin ela’its ne’ets quin tamcuy in ja’ubchic ani in at q’uimathchic quin ucha’: Cu junax culbejits cum te u ela’its an tumin ax u q’uibamal.
Antsana’ nan tu uchalchic abal ne’ets ca c’athpich junax culbe an ángelchic tam jun i hualbith inic ca jic’tson c’al in hualab ani ca huenc’on c’al a Dios.
An jalpith cau c’al an cuitol axi q’uibenec
A Jesús in uchaye an fariseochic ani an exobchixchic c’al an ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés antse’: ―C’uajatac jun i inic ax in cua’al tsab in cuitolil.
Uchan c’al an talbel cuitol: Tata, tiquim pitha’ an c’alab jahua’ bijithits ne’ets tiquim pitha’. Tam in tata an cuitol in caltha’ an tumin ani im pitha’ axi tsab in cuitolil.
Tsab ox a q’uicha tam an talbel cuitol in tala’ tamcuy jahua’ in cua’al, ani ta c’ale al i pil bichou lej ou. Tats ti xe’tsitsil quithab pacucul c’al an tumin.
In tala’ pacuhuits. Tam hua’tsin jun i pulic jayil al nixe’ xi bichou, ani lej c’a’il an cuitol.
Tam c’ale quin conoy i t’ojlab, ani pithan i t’ojlab ti beletnanchix c’al i olom.
Cum c’al ni jita’ yab u pithnal ti c’apul, ma in le’ac quin c’apu an tsamal axi ne’ets quim pijchixna’ c’al an olom.
Tam in tsalpachiquiyal: Axi yan i t’ojonchix tin q’uima’ u tata in cua’al yan jant’o quin c’apu ma hua’ats i jilc’omach, ani nana’ teje’ in tsemelits c’al an jayil.
Ne’ets quin huichiy c’al u tata cu ucha’ abal in hualbinenequits c’al a Dios ani in hualbinenequits c’al jaja’.
Jaxtam yabats in tomnal tiquim bats’u ejtil max pel tin tsacamil, expith tiquim bats’u ejtil max pel tin t’ojnalil, cu ucha’.

Tamna’ ta c’ale an cuitol tin q’uima’ in tata. Tam ti ohue ti tal, tam ti tsu’tatits ani lej yajnanchat c’al in tata. Tam athlats in tata ani im bats’u an cuitol c’al i muts’uc’naxtalab ani c’al i ts’uts’baxtalab.
Tam an cuitol in ucha’ in tata: Tata, in hualbinenequits c’al a Dios ani in hualbinenequits c’al tata’. Yabats in tomnal tiquim bats’u ejtil max pel tin tsacamil.

Aba ani’ antsana’ in ulu an cuitol, bel in tata in ucha’ an t’ojnalchic: Ca thubat caltha’ an huinat alhua’ toltom ca alhua’ toltomiyat an cuitol. Ca punchin tin c’ubac jun i anillo ani ca cay’chin i pajablab.
Ca chi’tha’chic an novillo axi alabel t’u’uthmethachits ani ca tsemtha’. Qui t’aja’ an ajib, cu ts’alat c’aputs.

Cum u cuitolil u tsalpay hualam max tsemetsits, ani iba cuchic cum xo’ te ulnec ejat. U tsalpay hualam max q’uibenequits, ani iba cuchic cum xo’ te c’uajat c’al huahua’, in ulu an tatalab. Tam in ts’i’quiychic quin t’aja’ an ajib.
Xe’etsnenec an oc’ox cuitol ti t’ojnal tin tsabalil in tata, ani xo’ u huichelits tin q’uima’. Tam ti utatits ne’ets ca ulits in ats’a’ an t’enelchic ani in tsu’u exom am bixom.
Tam in caniy ca chich jun i cuitol ani in conoy jant’o in t’ajalchic tihua’.
Uchan: In t’ajalchic an ajib cum huichits a ebchal. Cum in chi’thamal tim ba’ alhua’, jaxtam a tata in tsemthanchamal an novillo axi alabel t’u’uthmethachits.
Tam tsacuy an oc’ox cuitol, ma yab in le’ ca otsits tin q’uima’. Tam c’ale in tata abal quin lej ucha’ ca otsits.

An cuitol tocat in ucha’ in tata: A tso’obits abal yanits i tamub nan tu t’ojonchamal a c’al, ani ma yab a le’ tiquim pitha’ jun i chivo abal cu t’aja’ an ajib c’al u ja’ubchic. Ani ni jayq’ui’ yab in jec’om c’al tata’.
Nixe’ xa cuitolil expith xe’tsitslats quithab pacucul c’al an tumin c’al i uxum, ani xo’ huichits ani a tsemthanchamal an novillo axi alabel t’u’uthmethachits.
Tam uchan an oc’ox cuitol c’al in tata: Cuitol, ets’ey it c’uajat c’al nana’ ani patal jahua’ u cua’al tu c’al nana’ pelits a c’alte.

In tomnal qui t’aja’ an ajib ani cu lej culbe cum u tsalpay hualam max tsemetsits a ebchal, ani iba cuchic cum xo’ te ulnec ejat. U tsalpay hualam max q’uibenequits, ani iba cuchic cum xo’ te c’uajat c’al huahua’.
